bands.text: An old man fell off a ladder in the dark.

replay.find: A circular depressed fracture, 34 mm across
replay.note: Two head injuries on opposite sides of the skull. A fall strikes once.

replay.find: No fitting on the ladder or platform rail carries a knurled or criss-cross surface.
replay.note: So the patterned wound did not come from the ladder.

replay.find: The other three are dusty; this one is clean.
replay.note: The weapon: a 34 mm knurled counterweight, wiped and put back.
Hale was alive at 01:37, using the hand paddle in the dome.

replay.find: The splintering of the frame is on the inside face.
replay.note: The door was levered from inside the room. The locked room was staged.
The forged log jumps from #4471 to #4478: six events are missing.
And its own footer counts 11 events while it shows five.
The full record: Lindqvist's code opened the dome at 01:24.
At 07:08 Brackley's code opened the door and it swung open. It was never bolted.

replay.find: I was at my desk the whole time.
replay.note: Lindqvist's account fails against the door record and his idle workstation.
Nobody touched his workstation from 01:23 to 02:06.
The price of the cover-up, paid at 06:41, before the 'discovery'.

replay.find: I will put this to Dr Lindqvist myself tonight
replay.note: The motive: Hale was about to expose the faked comet discovery.

debrief: When did you first stop trusting D-1, and was it the sequence numbers or the footer?
Did you spend an Authority clearing someone the file had already cleared?
Was naming two people harder than finding one?

badges.title: Caught the forgery
badges.text: Saw through the doctored door log in The Ashcombe Dome.
